$comment: Permission scope for the UNATTENDED /night-prep run only (samurai-night-shift.ps1 + the 'Samurai Night Shift' scheduled task). Loaded with --settings so interactive sessions are unaffected. Deliberately NOT bypassPermissions: this list is everything the command needs and nothing else. /night-prep reads Jira and GitHub and writes only into the vault's night-shift folder, so every Notion permission from the open-tickets template is dropped here, and it never mirrors anywhere. Task is allowed because /night-prep dispatches two read-only subagents (a prior-art sweep and a flow trace); without it both are silently denied and the dossier comes back hollow. Bash(pwsh:*) is allowed because /night-prep's final step runs the PowerShell 7 validator at samurai-night-validate.ps1. Known limitation: the Composio execute tool takes its target as an argument, so a permission rule cannot tell a Jira read from a Jira write or a Chatwork send apart; the narrow scope here rests on /night-prep's own instructions, not on this permission layer.
